Can you tell me how to kill the lights in my room?

To turn off the lights:

- Flip the wall switch to **off**.
- If they’re smart lights, use the app or say, “Turn off the lights.”
- If the switch doesn’t work, check whether a lamp has its own switch or whether the circuit breaker has tripped—don’t open wiring or remove fixtures.
